candidateDedup.encoding: All generic candidates on the same key are collapsed into one row. isBreakout/isPullback/isSweep record which setup families fired.
candidateDedup.representativeCandidate: The first generated candidate is used only to call the frozen trigger_close plan builder; trigger_close stop/target geometry does not depend on setup_level.

splitPurity.fit: Candidate signal and worst-case baseline exit (signal + 4 entry-wait bars + holding horizon + 1) must both be strictly before 2025-10-01.
splitPurity.development: Candidate signal and worst-case baseline exit must both be strictly before 2026-01-01.
splitPurity.boundaryCandidates: Discarded rather than allowed to cross split boundaries.

featureDefinitions.clv: (close-low)/(high-low), clipped only for numerical safety to [0,1].
featureDefinitions.vol_ratio: ATR-percent / causal prior rolling ATR-percent median from compute_features.
featureDefinitions.next_open_gap_atr: direction-normalized next-open gap: sign(direction)*(nextOpen-signalClose)/ATR14. Positive means gap in trade direction.
featureDefinitions.actual_tp2_r: direction-normalized distance from nextOpen to frozen TP2 divided by actual initial risk.
featureDefinitions.htf_trend_signed: Previous completed higher-timeframe state encoded LONG=+1, SHORT=-1, neutral/unknown=0.
featureDefinitions.htf_neutral_flag: 1 only when previous completed HTF satisfies abs(EMA20-EMA50)<=0.50 ATR and abs(EMA50-EMA50[-5])<=0.50 ATR.
featureDefinitions.htfAligned: 1 when previous completed HTF trend state equals candidate direction.
featureDefinitions.vix_z60: Latest available completed daily VIX close minus 60-day rolling mean, divided by 60-day rolling std.
featureDefinitions.tnx_change5: Latest available completed daily US10Y close/close[-5]-1.

contextAvailability: A daily context row timestamped D becomes available only at D + 1 UTC day. Merge-asof uses only availabilityTime <= candidate entry timestamp.

modelFit.population: Only candidate rows whose frozen baseline plan is valid and actually enters.
modelFit.logisticTarget: 1 if base-cost frozen baseline net R > 0 else 0.
modelFit.models: Exactly the fixed models and hyperparameters in the parent lock.

developmentScreen.selection: Use the fixed parent-lock conjunction: ensemble predictedNetR>=0.10, Ridge>0, HGB>0, pWinScore>=0.55.
developmentScreen.utility: Selected candidate realized baseline netR; abstained candidate utility=0.
developmentScreen.baselineComparator: All eligible development candidates' realized frozen baseline netR.
developmentScreen.opportunityAudit: 1.5 ATR favorable before 1.0 ATR adverse over frozen holding horizon; adverse wins same-bar.

modelScoreSemantics: pWinScore is a classifier score only. No calibrated probability, confidence percentage or production probability claim is allowed from IFE1 development.

metricBreadth.activeFamily: A market family with at least one selected trade.
metricBreadth.activeBlock: A symbol/timeframe block with at least one selected trade.
metricBreadth.concentration: Maximum positive family total netR divided by sum of positive family total netR.

forbidden: No feature addition/removal after development outcomes.
No symbol feature or symbol-specific patch.
No opening validation/holdout unless every development gate passes.
